parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet frame forms the main structural body of the storage cabinet, made of wood panels.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support and houses the shelves and doors, maintaining the cabinet’s shape and stability.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving part that supports all other components.

parts.name: Shelf
parts.Basic_description: A horizontal wooden shelf inside the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It supports stored items and divides the cabinet space into sections.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed or occasionally adjustable but does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Shelf
parts.Basic_description: A middle shelf providing additional storage space.
parts.Functional_description: It supports items placed within the cabinet and helps organize storage.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary or can be repositioned if adjustable.

parts.name: Shelf
parts.Basic_description: Another internal shelf dividing the cabinet vertically.
parts.Functional_description: It provides a stable surface for storing items.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed or adjustable but not movable during use.

parts.name: Shelf
parts.Basic_description: The topmost internal shelf of the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It supports items and helps organize the upper section of the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed or adjustable but not movable during use.

parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: A front door panel of the cabinet with a handle for access.
parts.Functional_description: It allows access to the cabinet’s interior and protects stored items from dust.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about hinges to open and close.

parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: Another door panel located on the front of the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It provides access to a separate compartment of the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It swings open and closed on hinges.

parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: A door panel located on the upper section of the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It covers and protects the upper storage area.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates on hinges for opening and closing.

parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: A door panel located on the topmost section of the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It provides access to the top compartment and protects stored items.
parts.Movement_description: It swings open and closed using hinges.
